name: Cinnamon Buns
source:
“Cinnamon Buns” is an adult visual novel game about a girl leaving her hometown for college.
As her story unfolds, she will meet many charming characters living their own lives, discover many interesting things about herself and the world around her
and, maybe, find love and companionship. Some mystery and fantastical elements planned.
translation:
《肉桂卷》（Cinnamon Buns）是一款成人视觉小说游戏，讲述了一名离开家乡前往大学求学的女孩的故事。
随着剧情徐徐展开，她将邂逅许多各自过着精彩人生的迷人角色，发掘关于自己与周遭世界的诸多趣事，或许还能收获爱情与陪伴。游戏计划融入部分悬疑与奇幻元素。
